permittedTransformations.rule: TypeScript printer output must remain structurally identical
React probes import react-colorful; Octane probes import @octanejs/colorful
Upstream .tsx components and .ts hooks map to .tsrx counterparts in the adapted program
Upstream styles.css.d.ts is pristine-only; Octane uses css/styles.ts string export evidence
Paired FormEvent vs InputEvent proofs normalize to HostInputEvent for structural compare while remaining distinct at each lane
Matching @ts-expect-error controls must reject the same invalid call shapes on both sides

divergences.upstreamResult: HexColorInput residual host onInput is typed as React.FormEventHandler<HTMLInputElement> (synthetic FormEvent).
divergences.octaneResult: HexColorInput residual host onInput is typed with Octane native InputEvent attributes.
divergences.rationale: Octane has no synthetic event layer; public color onChange callbacks remain strings while residual host handlers use native DOM event types.
